workload.motionPolicy: Valid stationary actual server-projected arrival coordinates; each frame executes real membership/control/geometry/dirty tick. Staggered deadlines/single-flight normal ACK; no replay bursts. Pause fault continues nominal stationary sends until transport disconnection, counts them separately from readable cadence. No production movement-limit relaxation.
workload.pointerPolicy: At least 50 ms between generator sends, single-flight normal ACK, and at least 50 ms after a normal ACK before the next send. Captured socket/subscription guard prevents stale completion from releasing a new send. The paused-reader fault keeps its nominal 20 Hz send policy. Supplied current subscriptionId, bounded coordinates and one actual selected element ID. Maximum requested 20 Hz; achieved readable 18..20.5 Hz remains required. A fresh connection resets only volatile pending flags/deadlines; held old completions cannot block or release its current send.
workload.sceneWriteDescription: Each actor updates one of six independent ~22KiB notes perhouse with higher version/fixedlength text; fresh mutationUUID and captured original identity/house; one outstanding HTTP patch peractor, skippeddeadline counted andfails workload gate
workload.httpBudget: Scene120+chat12=132writes/minute/actor plus <=25bootstrap writes withinfirstminute; reads/downloads counted separately; never raise240/session/min endpoint bounds
workload.measurements: Send-to-actual Socket.IO visibility, sender plus all6boardviews/house; every intent target remains pending until observed orrecovered. Higher observed objectversion satisfiesearlier savedversion. Paused65s chatbacklog is about78 messages andfits100retention. Finalrecovery compareslatest100 scheduledchat IDsbycommitted receiptsequence; olderretiredchat iscounted asintentdelivery butnotincorrectlyrequired toremain forever.
workload.deadlineAccounting: Collapsed scene and chat deadlines are counted as skipped and fail the workload gate. Send at most one current intent after a late callback; do not burst catch-up chats. At 14 seconds with scene deadline 500 ms and chat deadline 5000 ms, count 27 skipped scene slots and one skipped chat slot.

measurement.server: Fresh child process invoking real createService; processRSS/heap/external/arrayBuffers, monitorEventLoopDelay andCPU sampled100ms; save sanitized one-second series plus maxima; clients/generatorRSS excluded
measurement.queues: Read-only wrappers inspect actual Engine.IO writeBuffer/ws bufferedAmount immediately before and after every sendPacket and at 100 ms samples. Known control packets without data contribute header overhead; unknown payload types fail telemetry. Neither authority nor transport handlers are replaced.
measurement.sourceFreeze: Check runtime source hashes, exact protocol bytes and instrument before start, in the child, every 10 seconds and at finish. Protocol/instrument/runtime drift all produce ABORTED consistently in file and console. Documentation or HEAD changes outside the source manifest do not change runtime identity.
measurement.privacy: No rawactor IDs, cookies, invitationcodes, command text, sceneJSON orserverlogs committed. Per-viewindices/counts, aggregateoutcomes, numeric telemetry andsource/contenthashes only; rawtempSQLite ignored .local
measurement.httpBudget: Record per-actor aggregate totals andmaximum rolling60second boardHTTP read/writecounts, includingbootstrap, assetdownloads andfinalreads; never outputidentity/cookie/request text. <=240/lane gate.
measurement.recovery: Final recovery verifies all 202 seed IDs, 20 tombstones, exact untouched and latest payloads, latest 100 retained scheduled chats by receipt sequence and two metadata-only files per house. Immediate slow-recovery grading captures the actual immutable subscribe cursor and snapshot, awaits only HTTP writes already started before its ACK, then grades the per-receipt version journal and latest 100 seed/scheduled chats through that cursor. Future writes cannot invalidate that snapshot, and missing cutoff state cannot pass.
measurement.inbound: Read actual Engine.IO maxHttpBufferSize from the isolated running service; it must remain 16384 bytes.
measurement.scopes: Check every board envelope schemaVersion1/currentsubscriptionId/actualhouseId and every initialgame self/home; discarded staleepochs counted separately, wrongcurrentepoch/house fails. Never persist raw IDs.

storageAcceptance.scope: Sum board+house retained receipt response octet_length growth from post-bootstrap/pre-measurement baseline through final live sample; includes tagged BLOB and actual SQLite TEXT encoding. New stricter engineering target, not lifetime disk/spare volume/billing proof.
storageAcceptance.measurement: Baseline/final type/count/actual stored byte sums; every100ms sample records each of3DB main/WAL/SHM logical+allocated bytes and sampled maxima, plus after-server-close/pre-decode and post-decode file snapshots. No decoded JSON size substituted for stored/allocation bytes.
storageAcceptance.exactReplay: Capture every successful boardACK from original actor/request/body by actor+commandID digest; identical duplicates dedup, different ACK never overwrites. Timed captures hash only after original receipt/reflection observation points. After server exit, bounded64-row read-only batches validate stored metadata, decode via actual codec and compare original digest; full distinct row coverage required. No full response history retained in memory.
storageAcceptance.originalGateChanges: None. Original21gate executable line, cadence/deadline/fault/duration/capacity/visibility/RSS inputs remain unchanged. Two independent prospective storage/exact-replay gates are added.
